shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; rg -n -i -C 3 "navigation|app shell|router" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; echo ---- ; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls -R src; cat src/*; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules | grep -i router

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "---- peer deps:"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | grep -A8 '"peerDependencies"'; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; echo "---- local docs:"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null | head -30
npm install @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname 2>&1 | grep -E "added|up to date|ERR" ; grep -A6 '"dependencies"' package.json; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json

echo "===== navigation README (setup) ====="; rg -n -i -C 6 "setup|install|import .*styles|css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -80; echo; echo "===== navigation docs index ====="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs; sed -n 1,120p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components; wc -l $D/AsideHeader.md; rg -n -C 3 "renderFooter|FooterItem|menuItems|onItemClick|logo|headerDecoration|renderContent|compact|MenuItem\b" $D/AsideHeader.md | head -220

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components; echo "===== AsideHeader props table / logo / item / footer ====="; sed -n 309,570p $D/AsideHeader.md | rg -n -C 2 "^\|.*(logo|menuItems|renderFooter|renderContent|headerDecoration|onItemClick|compact|hideCollapseButton|multipleTooltip|menuDensity|LogoProps|FooterItem|icon|current|title|onClick|href|iconSize)" | head -120; echo; echo "===== export types ====="; rg -n "export (type|interface) (AsideHeaderItem|MenuItem|LogoProps|FooterItemProps|AsideHeaderProps|AsideHeaderGeneralProps)\b" -A 40 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -260

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components; echo "== types.d.ts (MenuItem/Logo) =="; rg -n "export (type|interface) (MenuItem|LogoProps|AsideHeaderItem|SubheaderMenuItem)\b" -A 32 $E/types.d.ts | cut -c1-140 | head -120; echo "== FooterItem =="; cat $E/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-140 | head -40; ls $E/FooterItem; echo "== AsideHeader props =="; rg -n "renderFooter|renderContent|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton|menuItems|onChangeCompact|logo\?" $E/AsideHeader/types.d.ts $E/types.d.ts | cut -c1-160 | head -30

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; sed -n 55,72p $E/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | cut -c1-140; rg -n "RenderContentType" -A 3 $E/components/types.d.ts $E/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -12; echo "== exports =="; cat $E/index.d.ts | head -40; F=$(rg -l "FooterItemProps" $E/components --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3); echo "$F"; rg -n "FooterItemProps\b" -A 25 $E/components/FooterItem*.d.ts $E/components/*/FooterItem*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-140 | head -45

E=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components; cat $E/AsideHeader/index.d.ts; cat $E/index.d.ts | head -40; echo "== Content =="; cat $E/Content/*.d.ts | rg -n "RenderContentType|size" | head; echo "== FooterItem props =="; F=$(rg -l "FooterItemProps\b" $E --glob '*.d.ts' | grep -v MobileHeader | head -2); echo "$F"; for f in $F; do rg -n "FooterItemProps\b" -B2 -A 25 "$f" | cut -c1-140 | head -40; done
rg -n "AsideHeaderItem\b" -A 12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | cut -c1-140 | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Text Card Flex Button Icon Label Box Divider 2>&1 | head -60

I=node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; ls $I | head -5; f=$(ls $I/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls $I/*.d.ts | head -1); echo "file: $f"; rg -o -w "(House|Gear|Moon|Sun|Persons|Person|ListCheck|CircleCheck|Rocket|ChartColumn|Bell|Clock|Check|LayoutHeaderCellsLarge|ListUl|CircleInfo|Palette|SquareCheck|Cubes3|Cube|Display|Star|ArrowRight)" $f | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
rg -n "export type AsideHeaderItem\b|export interface AsideHeaderItem\b" -A 8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | cut -c1-140

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "== ThemeProvider =="; cat $U/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | cut -c1-140 | head -30; echo "== Switch =="; cat $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts | cut -c1-140; rg -n "interface ControlProps" -A 14 $U/components/types.d.ts | cut -c1-120; echo "== Card =="; rg -n "CardView|CardTheme|CardType|CardSize|export interface CardProps" -A 3 $U/Card/Card.d.ts | cut -c1-140 | head -40

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "== Text =="; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|export type TextVariant|variant\?|color\?|TEXT_COLORS" -A 2 $U/Text/Text.d.ts $U/Text/text/text.d.ts $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -40; echo "== Flex/Box =="; rg -n "direction\?|gap\?|alignItems\?|justifyContent\?|wrap\?|grow\?|spacing\?|as\?|width\?|maxWidth\?" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | cut -c1-160 | head -30; echo "== Label =="; rg -n "theme\?|size\?|export type LabelProps" -A 1 $U/Label/Label.d.ts | cut -c1-160 | head -20; echo "== Button view =="; rg -n "ButtonView" -A 4 $U/Button/Button.d.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -12

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n "interface ControlProps" -A 12 $U/types.d.ts | cut -c1-120; rg -n "useTheme|useThemeValue|getRootClassName" $U/theme/index.d.ts; rg -n "export type (Theme|RealTheme)\b" $U/theme/types.d.ts

python3 - <<'EOF' import re,io p='src/pages/TasksPage.tsx' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace(""" ""","""
""") open(p,'w').write(s) EOF npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
cat .gitignore && git status --short
rm -rf dist && printf 'dist/\n' >> .gitignore && git status --short
